description: This Python source file implements a prompt management system that integrates with BitBucket repositories, enabling loading, rendering, and managing prompts stored as .prompt files within BitBucket for use with LiteLLM. It includes classes for handling prompt templates, loading fromBitBucket, rendering with Jinja2, and managing prompts in a way compatible with LiteLLM's prompt management interface.

classes.name: BitBucketPromptTemplate
classes.description: Represents a prompt template loaded from BitBucket, encapsulating prompt metadata and content.

classes.name: BitBucketTemplateManager
classes.description: Handles loading, parsing, and rendering of prompt (.prompt) files from BitBucket repositories, supporting templating and metadata extraction.

classes.name: BitBucketPromptManager
classes.description: Integrates BitBucket prompt templates into LiteLLM's prompt management system, supporting template retrieval, rendering, and prompt lifecycle management.
